1.consolidated_definition: . Ñame. Forma ultracorrecta que aparece en algunos escritos, surgida del deseo evidente de esquivar el sonido inicial de ñ, asociado a pronunciaciones vulgarizantes.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Yam. A hypercorrect form appearing in some written works, arising from a evident desire to avoid the initial sound of ñ, associated with vulgarizing pronunciations.
